description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FinalResult" name="Level 2 scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ShowResultToClerk" name="Scoring result to clerk"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ShowDelayToClerk" name="Check again later message to clerk"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Clerk" name="Sales clerk (frontend)"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit scoring agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="Participant_Clerk" targetRef="StartEvent_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediate" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delay notification" sourceRef="Task_SendDelay" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FinalResult" name="Level 2 scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendFinal" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ShowImmediateResult" name="Scoring result to clerk" sourceRef="Task_PresentImmediate" targetRef="Participant_Clerk"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ShowDelay" name="Check again later message to clerk" sourceRef="Task_ShowDelay" targetRef="Participant_Clerk"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ShowFinalResult" name="Scoring result to clerk" sourceRef="Task_PresentFinal" targetRef="Participant_Clerk"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking system credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ClerkRequest" messageRef="Msg_ClerkRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AgencyResponse" name="Agency response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotification" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentImmediate" name="Present result to clerk" messageRef="Msg_ShowResultToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ShowDelay" name="Display check again later message to clerk" messageRef="Msg_ShowDelayToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Level 2 scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FinalResult" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentFinal" name="Present result to clerk" messageRef="Msg_ShowResultToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResult" name="Result presented"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalResult" name="Final result presented"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_AgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B3" sourceRef="Gateway_AgencyResponse" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B4" sourceRef="Gateway_AgencyResponse" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B5" sourceRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_PresentImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B6" sourceRef="Task_PresentImmediate" targetRef="End_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B7" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotification" targetRef="Task_ShowDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B8" sourceRef="Task_ShowDelay" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B9" sourceRef="Catch_FinalResult" targetRef="Task_PresentFinal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_B10" sourceRef="Task_PresentFinal" targetRef="End_FinalResult"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit scoring agency" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Agency" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResultAvailable" name="Result available immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediate" name="Send immediate result to banking system" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelay" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFinal" name="Send scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateAgency" name="Immediate result returned"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalAgency" name="Level 2 result returned"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_A1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Agency" targetRef="Task_Level1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_A2" sourceRef="Task_Level1" targetRef="Gateway_ResultAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_A3" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultAvailable" targetRef="Task_SendImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_A4" name="Delay" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultAvailable" targetRef="Task_SendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_A5" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediate" targetRef="End_ImmediateAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_A6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelay" targetRef="Task_Level2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_A7" sourceRef="Task_Level2" targetRef="Task_SendFinal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_A8" sourceRef="Task_SendFinal" targetRef="End_FinalAgency"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
